header: What maintenance teams run on Vertex Supply
subheadline: Six capabilities that cover the working day from the first call to the invoice. All of them are on every plan; the plans differ in how many technicians they cover and how quickly support answers.

feature_items.title: Scheduling and routing
feature_items.description: Assign by skill, certification and drive time, and see what a reassignment costs the rest of the day before you commit to it.

feature_items.title: Technician app
feature_items.description: Job sheets, checklists, photos and signatures on iOS and Android, cached for seven days so plant rooms and lift shafts are no obstacle.

feature_items.title: Asset register
feature_items.description: Serial numbers, warranty dates and full service history per unit, reachable from a QR label stuck to the equipment itself.

feature_items.title: Parts and van stock
feature_items.description: Stock counted at every close-out, reorder points per van, and a warning when the part a dispatcher just promised is three days out.

feature_items.title: SLA and contract tracking
feature_items.description: Response windows per contract, breach warnings 30 minutes ahead, and an audit trail your customer can be shown without editing.

feature_items.title: Reporting
feature_items.description: First-time fix rate, travel time and contract profitability, exported weekly to your reporting stack or straight to a spreadsheet.
